note: Read on 24 Nov 2026. The consumer credit catalogue is https://www.gsb.or.th/personal/credit-cash/. The /personal/card/ page is a category landing that also lists debit cards. div.category-lists.category-0 holds the 5 consumer credit cards; category-1 holds cash cards (PEOPLE CARD, PRIMA CARD) and is left out. An English /en/personal/card/ page exists but lists only GSB Debit Card and has no credit-card catalogue or promotions, so this run uses Thai. Pages include a recaptcha script for a form, so pipeline/fetcher.py classes them captcha; the public catalogue text is present in plain HTTP. Fees and qualifications are in images and PDFs linked from each product page.
